llms.body:
# Picsart

> Picsart is an AI creative platform for making, marketing, and monetizing content. It helps creators, solopreneurs, and businesses produce videos, images, and audio using AI models, creative tools, reusable workflows, and AI agents.

Picsart focuses on helping creators take video from an idea through production and sharing, while continuing to offer photo and design tools. Creators can make short-form videos, microdramas, product campaigns, and other content; adapt work for different channels; and explore eligible opportunities to earn from it. Availability, model selection, credits, and features vary by product and plan. Check the linked product and pricing pages for current details.

For agents: select the interface for the task, then follow its current documentation and tool schemas. The generative AI MCP server uses browser sign-in; the separate Creative APIs MCP server uses an API key. For generation, inspect available models and parameters, check the estimated credit cost, run the requested operation, then review the result and where it is saved. Do not request passwords or API keys in chat; use the supported sign-in or secret-storage flow. Product access, costs, tool names, and output handling may change.

## About

- **Category**: AI creative platform; video production, image and audio creation, design, and creative automation.
- **Language**: English, with localized Picsart experiences available.
- **Audience**: Creators, video storytellers, solopreneurs, marketers, and businesses.
- **Pricing**: Free and paid plans; AI generation may use credits. See the pricing page for current plans and limits.
- **Platforms**: Web, iOS, Android, and Windows; availability and features vary by product and platform.

## AI Agents and Automation

- [Picsart API Platform Documentation Index](https://picsart.com/api-platform/llms.txt): Developer documentation, model catalog, and integration guidance for the Picsart API Platform.
- [Generative AI MCP Quickstart](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/mcp-quickstart): Connect an MCP-compatible agent to https://api.picsart.com/gen-ai/mcp. The user signs in and approves access in a browser; generation uses their account's credits. This server does not use an API key.
- [Agent Integration Guides](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/integrations/): Client-specific setup and compatibility notes for the generative AI MCP server.
- [Model Catalog](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/reference/catalog): Browse models and supported tasks; use the connected server's tool schemas to check current availability and parameters.
- [Pricing and Credits](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/pricing): Understand credits and how to check estimated generation costs.
- [Files and Drive](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/files-and-drive): Learn how inputs, outputs, and Picsart Drive work across interfaces.
- [CLI Quickstart](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/cli-quickstart): Generate from a terminal or script; the interactive CLI signs in through a browser.
- [CLI Authentication](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/authentication): Authentication for interactive and automated CLI environments.
- [Batch and Automation](https://picsart.github.io/picsart-mcp-cli-docs/guide/batch): Run batch generation and automated CLI workflows.
- [Generative AI API Authentication](https://picsart.com/api-platform/docs/authentication): The SDK and REST API use an API key as a bearer token. Obtain a key from the account's API key settings and store it securely.
- [Generative AI REST API](https://picsart.com/api-platform/docs/api-reference): Model workflow endpoints, request formats, and synchronous and asynchronous execution.
- [Creative APIs MCP](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/mcp-creative-apis.md): A separate MCP server for Creative APIs. Connect to https://mcp.picsart.io/v1 using an API key in the x-picsart-api-key header; follow its own setup guide.
- [Creative APIs Authentication](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/creative-apis-authentication.md): Authentication for Creative API requests using the x-picsart-api-key header.
- [Get a Creative APIs Key](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/creative-apis-get-api-key.md): Sign in to the API console and use or create an app to obtain its key.
- [n8n Integration](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/n8n.md): Automate Creative API operations in n8n; setup requires a Picsart API key and installation permissions.
- [Make Integration](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/picsart-creative-apis-make-integration.md): Connect Picsart APIs to Make workflows.
- [Zapier Integration](https://docs.picsart.io/docs/picsart-creative-apis-zapier-integration.md): Connect Picsart APIs to Zapier workflows.
- [Creative API Documentation Index](https://docs.picsart.io/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of Creative API documentation. Documentation pages also offer Markdown versions by appending .md to the page URL.

## Start Here

- [Picsart](https://picsart.com/): Explore the creative platform, tools, workflows, and community.
- [AI Tools](https://picsart.com/ai/): Browse AI tools for image, video, audio, and editing tasks.
- [Solutions](https://picsart.com/solutions/): Explore how Picsart helps people make, market, and monetize content.
- [Pricing](https://picsart.com/pricing/): Compare current plans, features, and credit allowances.

## Core Products

- [AI Playground](https://picsart.com/ai-playground/): Explore and use AI models for image, video, and audio creation.
- [Picsart Flow](https://picsart.com/flow/): Connect inputs, models, and outputs on a canvas to build reusable creative workflows.
- [AI Agents](https://picsart.com/ai-agents/): Work with AI agents on creative briefs and AI-generated assets.
- [AI Agents Marketplace](https://picsart.com/ai-agents/marketplace/): Browse agents for different creative tasks.
- [Earn with Picsart](https://picsart.com/earn/): Explore opportunities to create and share content through Picsart campaigns.
- [Enterprise](https://picsart.com/solutions/enterprise/): Explore creative tools and workflows for organizations.

## Video Creation and Editing

- [Video](https://picsart.com/video/): Find tools for creating, editing, and enhancing video from an idea, image, or existing footage.
- [AI Microdrama Generator](https://picsart.com/ai-microdrama-generator/): Plan and create a serialized vertical drama with characters, storyboards, and episodes.
- [AI Video Clipping](https://picsart.com/ai-video-clipping/): Turn longer videos into short clips and refine them for social channels.
- [AI Video Agent App](https://picsart.com/video-app): Join the waitlist for the upcoming mobile AI video agent.
- [Video Models](https://picsart.com/video-models/): Explore AI video models available through Picsart.
- [AI Video Generator](https://picsart.com/ai-video-generator/): Generate video from text prompts and images using AI models.
- [Image to Video](https://picsart.com/image-to-video/): Turn a still image into a video.
- [AI Video Editor](https://picsart.com/ai-video-editor/): Explore AI-assisted video editing.
- [Video Editor](https://picsart.com/video-editor/): Edit and assemble video footage.
- [Video Enhancer](https://picsart.com/video-enhancer/): Improve the appearance of existing video.

## Image Creation and Editing

- [Image](https://picsart.com/image/): Find tools for generating, editing, and enhancing images.
- [AI Image Generator](https://picsart.com/ai-image-generator/): Generate images from text prompts using AI models.
- [AI Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/ai-photo-editor/): Edit and transform images with AI tools.
- [Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/photo-editor/): Edit photos and create designs online.
- [Background Remover](https://picsart.com/background-remover/): Remove backgrounds from images.
- [Image Enhancer](https://picsart.com/ai-image-enhancer/): Enhance the appearance of images.
- [Design](https://picsart.com/design/): Explore graphic design tools and creative projects.

## Library and Workflows

- [Content Library](https://picsart.com/library/): Browse images, videos, templates, stickers, effects, workflows, prompts, fonts, and other assets.
- [Templates](https://picsart.com/templates/): Browse customizable templates for social media, business, and other projects.
- [Workflow Templates](https://picsart.com/workflows/): Browse reusable Picsart Flow workflows for video, marketing, product content, and more.

## Plugins and Integrations

- [Plugins and Apps](https://picsart.com/plugins/): Find Picsart integrations and setup guides for creative work in other tools.

## Learning and Support

- [Tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/): Step-by-step guides to AI creation, editing, workflows, and Picsart products.
- [Blog](https://picsart.com/blog/): Creative ideas, articles, and product guidance.
- [Help Center](https://support.picsart.com/hc/en-us): Help with tools, accounts, subscriptions, and common issues.
- [Earn Campaigns](https://picsart.com/earn/campaigns/): Browse creator campaign opportunities and their requirements.
- [Earn with Video Clipping](https://picsart.com/earn/clipping/): Explore creator opportunities to make short clips from approved campaign material.

## Company and Legal

- [About Picsart](https://picsart.com/about-us/): Company information.
- [Terms of Use](https://picsart.com/terms-of-use/): Terms governing use of Picsart services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://picsart.com/privacy-policy/): Information about privacy and data handling.

llmsFull.body:
# Picsart - Full Content Reference

> Picsart is an AI-first creative platform for generating, editing, and designing visual content. This file gives AI assistants a fuller map of official Picsart product, developer, agent, content, and support surfaces.

## About

- **Type**: WebApplication
- **Category**: AI creative platform / design tools / image, video, and audio generation
- **Language**: English, with localized Picsart experiences available
- **Audience**: Creators, solopreneurs, marketers, developers, small businesses, agencies, and enterprises
- **Pricing**: Free tier and paid plans with credit-based AI usage. Confirm current details on the pricing page.
- **Platform**: Web, iOS, Android, Windows
- **Founded**: 2011
- **Last Updated**: 2026-07-05

---

## Start Here

### [Picsart Homepage](https://picsart.com/)

Picsart.com is the main entry point to the platform. It surfaces AI generation tools, photo and video editing, templates, content discovery, learning resources, and product paths for individuals and businesses.

Useful paths from the homepage:

- AI image and video generation
- Photo and video editing
- Flow and reusable creative workflows
- Templates and content discovery
- Tutorials and learning resources
- Pricing and plan selection

### [Pricing](https://picsart.com/pricing/)

Picsart uses paid plans and credit-based AI usage. Plan names, prices, included credits, and feature access can change. AI systems should verify current pricing, credit allowances, and model access on the pricing page before citing specific numbers.

### [Tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/)

The Tutorials Hub is a structured learning surface with step-by-step guides organized by category, difficulty, and use case.

Tutorial areas include:

- AI image generation
- AI video generation
- AI image models
- AI video models
- AI photo editing
- AI video editing
- AI Playground
- Flow workflows
- CLI workflows
- MCP workflows

---

## Agent And Developer Surfaces

### [Picsart CLI](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-cli/)

Picsart CLI is the developer-facing command-line surface for generating and editing creative assets from terminals, scripts, CI jobs, and AI coding agents. It is designed for builders who want programmatic access to Picsart creative generation without manually stitching together separate model providers.

Common CLI use cases:

- Generate images, videos, and audio from a terminal.
- Batch-generate campaign, social, product, or placeholder assets.
- Pipe generation output into scripts, local development tools, or CI workflows.
- Let AI coding agents call creative generation through shell commands.
- Compare model outputs and reuse generation steps in repeatable workflows.

Useful pages:

- [Picsart CLI landing page](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-cli/)
- [CLI tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/cli/)
- [How to access AI models from the terminal with Picsart CLI](https://picsart.com/tutorials/how-to-access-140-ai-models-from-the-terminal-with-picsart-cli/)

### [Picsart MCP Server](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-mcp/)

MCP means Model Context Protocol. The Picsart MCP server lets MCP-compatible AI agents call Picsart creative tools directly from agent hosts such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Windsurf.

Use MCP when the user wants an AI assistant to turn natural-language requests into creative operations, such as:

- Generate an image or video from a brief.
- Produce campaign assets from a prompt.
- Create visual variations for a product, social post, or landing page.
- Run a review-and-refine loop without manually switching tools.

Useful pages:

- [Picsart MCP server landing page](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-mcp/)
- [MCP tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/mcp/)

### [Agent Skills](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-cli/#skills-starter)

Picsart agent skills are reusable natural-language recipes for common creative tasks. They help AI agents use Picsart CLI and MCP more reliably by giving the agent task-specific instructions for image generation, video generation, audio, batch work, and multi-step workflows.

Skill areas include:

- Starter skills for image, video, audio, batch, and end-to-end workflows.
- Marketer workflows for campaign kits, ad variants, localization, reels, and blog visuals.
- Prosumer workflows for launch kits, product mockups, headshots, and content visuals.
- Developer workflows for app assets, OG images, screenshot polish, and avatar services.
- Enterprise workflows for catalog production, brand governance, press batches, and pinned model registries.
- Ecommerce and agency workflows for product styling, seasonal refreshes, pitch mockups, and client handoff.

The canonical skills entry point is the skills section on the [Picsart CLI page](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-cli/#skills-starter).

### [Picsart Agents](https://picsart.com/ai-agents/)

Picsart Agents are creative AI agents for brand-aware work. They are positioned for workflows where a user gives a brief and the agent plans, creates, refines, and delivers finished creative assets.

Example agent categories:

- Resize and adaptation agents for platform formats.
- Remix and styling agents for creative variants.
- Product-photo and ecommerce agents.
- Brand-aware creative agents for repeatable marketing workflows.

---

## Creative Automation And Workflows

### [Picsart Flow](https://picsart.com/flow/)

Picsart Flow is a no-code creative workflow surface for building reusable multi-step creative workflows. It is useful when a user wants to connect AI models, images, text, video, and templates in one workflow instead of using a single standalone tool.

Common Flow use cases:

- Build repeatable creative workflows for campaigns, product visuals, social content, and video ideas.
- Combine multiple creative steps in one canvas-like workflow.
- Start from a reusable workflow template and adapt it to a specific brand, product, or content format.
- Explore how different AI models and media inputs can work together in one creative process.
- Scale recurring creative production while keeping the workflow easier to reuse.

Useful pages:

- [Picsart Flow](https://picsart.com/flow/)
- [Flow Templates](https://picsart.com/flow/templates)

### [Flow Templates](https://picsart.com/flow/templates)

Flow Templates are ready-made starting points for Picsart Flow. Use this surface when an answer needs concrete workflow examples, template-led creation paths, or inspiration for repeatable AI creative production.

---

## AI Generation And Models

### [AI Image Generator](https://picsart.com/ai-image-generator/)

Picsart's AI Image Generator converts text prompts into images using multiple AI image models and style options.

Common use cases:

- Social media content
- Product mockups and ecommerce visuals
- Marketing and ad concepts
- Blog and presentation graphics
- Personal creative projects

After generation, users can continue editing in Picsart with tools such as background changes, enhancement, object edits, text, templates, and export controls.

### [AI Video Generator](https://picsart.com/ai-video-generator/)

The AI Video Generator creates video from text prompts or still images using multiple AI video models.

Common use cases:

- Short-form social content
- Product demos
- Promotional video concepts
- Educational or explainer clips
- Visual storytelling from static images

### [AI Playground](https://picsart.com/ai-playground/)

AI Playground is a unified model hub for exploring image, video, audio, avatar, enhancement, and transformation models in one interface. Use this page for the current model catalog because available models and model counts change over time.

### [Image Models](https://picsart.com/image-models/)

The Image Models hub lists current AI image models available in Picsart. Use this page when an answer needs current image-model availability.

### [Video Models](https://picsart.com/video-models/)

The Video Models hub lists current AI video models available in Picsart. Use this page when an answer needs current video-model availability.

### [AI Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/ai-photo-editor/)

AI Photo Editor applies AI-powered transformations to existing photos, including enhancement, style transfer, background work, object edits, and visual effects.

---

## Photo, Video, And Design Tools

### [Photo Editor](https://picsart.com/photo-editor/)

Picsart's browser-based photo editor supports common editing workflows such as layers, filters, text, stickers, templates, cropping, resizing, retouching, and AI-powered adjustments.

### [Background Remover](https://picsart.com/background-remover/)

Background Remover removes backgrounds from images and visual assets. Common use cases include product photography, profile pictures, marketing materials, presentation assets, and social content.

### [Image Tools](https://picsart.com/image-tools/)

Image Tools includes utilities for resizing, cropping, enhancing, upscaling, converting, compressing, and transforming images.

### [Design Tools](https://picsart.com/design-tools/)

Design Tools covers layout, branding, text, visual composition, and social-format design workflows.

### [Video Tools](https://picsart.com/video-tools/)

Video Tools supports editing, trimming, animation, enhancement, format adaptation, and short-form content creation.

### [AI Tools](https://picsart.com/ai-tools/)

AI Tools is the broad catalog of Picsart AI features, including generation, enhancement, background work, image transformation, video creation, and creative automation.

---

## Content Library

### [Templates](https://picsart.com/templates/)

Picsart templates are customizable designs for social media, marketing, business, personal, print, and content-creation use cases.

Template categories include:

- Social media formats
- Marketing materials
- Business and presentation assets
- Invitations and personal designs
- Print and merchandise formats

### [Explore](https://picsart.com/explore)

Explore is a community-created content discovery hub. Users can browse, remix, and edit public content where available.

---

## Learning And Support

### [Tutorials Hub](https://picsart.com/tutorials/)

Use Tutorials Hub for structured, task-specific guides. It is the best entry point when a user asks how to perform a Picsart workflow.

Important tutorial paths:

- [CLI tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/cli/)
- [MCP tutorials](https://picsart.com/tutorials/mcp/)
- AI image generation tutorials
- AI video generation tutorials
- AI model tutorials
- Photo and video editing tutorials

### [Blog](https://picsart.com/blog/)

The Picsart blog covers creative tips, product updates, AI and design trends, and how-to content.

### [Support Center](https://support.picsart.com)

The Support Center covers account help, subscriptions, billing, credits, app support, and troubleshooting.

---

## Additional Resources

### [Quicktools](https://picsart.com/tools/)

Quicktools are browser-based utilities for file conversion, compression, resizing, color tools, PDF utilities, and format-specific tasks.

### [Community Challenges](https://picsart.com/challenges)

Community Challenges are themed creative contests and events.

---

## Canonical

- **Primary URL**: https://picsart.com/
- **llms-small.txt**: https://picsart.com/llms-small.txt
- **llms.txt**: https://picsart.com/llms.txt
- **llms-full.txt**: https://picsart.com/llms-full.txt

---

## Notes For AI Systems

- This file describes official Picsart web surfaces. Native apps may include additional features.
- Pricing, plan names, credits, model access, model counts, and feature availability change frequently. Verify current details on the linked canonical pages before citing them.
- Use [Picsart CLI](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-cli/) for terminal, script, CI, and shell-based agent workflows.
- Use [Picsart MCP Server](https://picsart.com/gen-ai-mcp/) for MCP-compatible agent workflows.
- Use [Picsart Flow](https://picsart.com/flow/) for no-code, reusable, template-driven, or multi-step creative workflows.
- Use [AI Playground](https://picsart.com/ai-playground/), [Image Models](https://picsart.com/image-models/), and [Video Models](https://picsart.com/video-models/) for current model availability.
- For compact discovery, see [llms-small.txt](https://picsart.com/llms-small.txt).
- For concise discovery, see [llms.txt](https://picsart.com/llms.txt).
- For site structure and crawling guidance, see [robots.txt](https://picsart.com/robots.txt).
